name: Rabbah
overview: Rabbah, also known as Rabbath, is a notable city east of the Jordan River originally belonging to the Ammonites, where the iron bedstead of the giant Og was kept (Deuteronomy 3:11). It was captured by King David but later came under Ammonite control again, as reflected in the prophetic warnings of desolation and captivity pronounced by the Lord through Jeremiah (Jeremiah 49:2-3). Additionally, Rabbah is mentioned as a city within the territory of Judah (Joshua 15:60), underscoring its geographical and historical significance in biblical narrative. Ezekiel also foretells judgment involving Rabbath of the Ammonites, linking it with divine warfare and the fate of Jerusalem (Ezekiel 21:20).
